description: This Java source file defines the DepositRecurringDetail class, which encapsulates the details of a recurring deposit in a banking or financial application within the Fineract project. It includes properties such as whether the deposit is mandatory, whether withdrawal is allowed, and whether to adjust advance payments towards future payments. The class provides methods for creation, updating based on JSON commands, copying, and getters for its fields.

classes.name: DepositRecurringDetail
classes.description: Represents the details of a recurring deposit, including whether it is mandatory, allows withdrawal, and adjusts to future payments. It is embeddable in a JPA entity and provides update, copy, and getter methods.
